name: POS Order Cost Validation
description: The POS Order Cost Validation module helps retailers protect profitability by preventing sales below cost price in Odoo Point of Sale system. It automatically checks each product’s selling price against its standard cost and alerts cashiers if a price is set too low. Business owners can configure the app to either warn staff or block such transactions entirely.
summary: This module prevents sales below cost by alerting cashiers when a selling price is lower than the products standard cost. Ensure accurate pricing, protect your margins, and maintain full control over discounting in your retail operations. The POS Order Cost Validation module for Odoo helps businesses protect their profits by preventing sales below cost price in the Point of Sale system. With this app, cashiers and sales staff will automatically receive a warning whenever they attempt to sell a product at a price lower than its standard cost. By automatically loading product cost prices into the POS session, the module can validate every price input in real time. Business owners can choose whether to simply warn cashiers or block below-cost sales completely. With this safeguard in place, companies can enforce pricing rules, control discount policies, and ensure consistent profitability across all retail operations.
